# Model Check

A **track** is one sequential line of work; steps in the same track never overlap, and anything that happens while something else happens belongs in a different track. A **step** has exactly one duration kind: `fixed` (a number of seconds), `variable` (min, max, and default seconds), or `indefinite` (runs until manually stopped). A **startTrigger** ties a step to the clock or to another step using one of six patterns: `programStart` (t=0), `programStartOffset` (t=offset), `afterStep` (when a named step ends or starts), `afterStepWithBuffer` (when a named step ends plus a delay), `manual` (user taps), or `compound` (logic combining multiple triggers). **stepId**s are unique across the WHOLE program, not per track, so no two steps anywhere can share an ID. Every `task` a step uses must have a matching `resourceConstraints` entry that declares `maxConcurrent` — that number is what prevents two steps from using the oven or both burners at once. Work repeated n times (n trays, n samples) uses `replicates: {count: n, mode: "serial" | "parallel" | "stagger"}` on ONE step, never copied; chain what happens for each repetition with `instances: "each"`, make the step that waits for all with `instances: "all"`, and when a holding area (cooling rack, rotor, taxiway) can only fit k items, set `maxInFlight: k` so the upstream step is held back instead of stranding downstream work.

For this three-course dinner with one cook, one oven, and two burners, I expect:

1. **oven** — maxConcurrent 1 (one oven, used for ribs and then tart)
2. **burner** — maxConcurrent 2 (two burners, one used for searing/building/soup/reducing, second for holding soup warm)
3. **prep** — maxConcurrent 1 (one cook, used for all knife work, plating, arrangement, slicing/service)

```json
{
  "acknowledgement": "tracks are sequential lines of work; one duration kind per step; triggers link steps; every task needs a resourceConstraint; stepIds are global",
  "resourceConstraints": [
    { "task": "oven", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "burner", "maxConcurrent": 2 },
    { "task": "prep", "maxConcurrent": 1 }
  ],
  "actors": 1
}
```
